packageRules.description: Ignore project revision property - managed by CI during release
Group npm updates per source repository (monorepo), fallback to per dependency
Resolve npm packages directly from npmjs.org instead of the Repox registry inherited from the shared preset
@typescript/native-preview - dev builds update daily, limit to weekly

Re-enable patch updates for the pinned mise Node version: it is pinned exactly (not fuzzy) so that mise.toml's text always matches the resolved runtime, keeping the JS test skip-cache and mise-action cache keys honest. That only works if patch releases land as real commits, so this overrides the shared preset's blanket 'no mise patch updates' rule for this one dependency.
